citation.description: Ticket description contains detailed root cause: 'When it is unset, Copilot sends an empty bearer, the server answers HTTP 401 with an OAuth WWW-Authenticate challenge, and Copilot reports Browser-based OAuth required / /mcp auth rebar (Copilot debug log, rmcp::transport::worker OAuthChallenge status_code 401).' Ticket comment attests: 'Copilot CLI MCP write check 2026-11-02: comment posted through the rebar MCP server from a non-interactive Copilot CLI session started in a clean environment.'

criteria.criterion: Root cause recorded on this ticket: empty bearer from non-interactive shells, reproduced with the variable unset (401 OAuth challenge) and set (tool call succeeds).
